signals.text: 2 open PM roles across 1 US office

bullets: Contribute to the product roadmap by gathering and synthesizing input from customers, stakeholders, and data.
Document clear product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria in collaboration with senior team members.
Conduct competitive research and user interviews to surface insights that inform product decisions.
Identify opportunities to unify user workflows across platform capabilities, incorporating AI-based functionality.
Own the product strategy, vision, and roadmap for UMA, SMA, and multi-sleeve portfolio construction, overlay trading, and rebalancing capabilities across the VAST platform.
Translate the operational realities of Portfolio Management — trading discretion, sleeve vs. account-level rebalancing, cash coordination across sleeves, tax overlay management…
Act as the internal subject-matter authority on UMA structures (sleeves, base sleeves, overlay managers, manager-traded sleeves, flexible/custom models) and how they intersect…
Partner with engineering and design to architect scalable solutions that serve both large wirehouse/broker-dealer UMA programs and asset manager/overlay manager workflows
Work directly with Portfolio Managers, overlay managers, and asset manager partners (both internal at VAS and external sponsor-side clients) to gather requirements and validate…
